sources.title: Ramos-Ramos/vicreg-resnet-50 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Weights converted from the official VICReg ResNet using this script. For up-to-date model card information, please see the original repo. How to use Warning: The feature extractor in this repo is a copy of the one from microsoft/resnet-50. We never verified if this image prerprocessing is the one used with VICReg ResNet-50.

sources.title: Using Pre-trained Models | facebookresearch/vicreg | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This document provides guidance on accessing and using the pre-trained VICReg models available in this repository. It covers the two primary access methods: PyTorch Hub integration for programmatic access and direct downloads for manual model loading.

sources.title: Available Models | facebookresearch/vicreg | DeepWiki
sources.snippet: This page catalogs all pre-trained VICReg models available for download and use, including their architecture specifications, performance metrics, and access methods. The models are available both through direct download links and PyTorch Hub integration.
